title: a JITSO handler written with an absolute path is replaced by the bare command, never duplicated
source: intended: docs/decisions.md D8 (setup hook, defect N-17): jitso registers its guard in the project's .claude/settings.json without clobbering anything
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-17, setup hook). A JITSO handler is a command whose first word is `jitso` or a quoted or absolute path ending in `jitso`, followed by `hook guard`. Such a legacy handler is removed and the desired groups are written: one Bash group, one orca MCP group, one file-writes group and one SessionEnd group, all with `jitso hook guard`, and nothing of `/old/place` is left. Since N-25 the guard also has a third PreToolUse group, `Write|Edit|MultiEdit|NotebookEdit`. The oracle has no `setup` command: it answers `unknown command "setup"` on stderr with exit 2 and prints nothing on stdout, so every expectation that needs this output or file effect FAILS on it.
